title: Sunny Saturday Crew
style: warm folk pop, female lead vocal sweet harmonies, acoustic guitar strumming, soft brushed drums, upright bass, light mandolin, sunny weekend feel, uplifting, 104 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Saturday morning, sun coming up
Michelle on the court with a coffee cup
Friends arriving, paddles in hand
Sweetest little crew in the whole wide land

[Verse 2]
Little bright ball bouncing in the light
Everyone laughing, everything bright
Michelle calls the warm-up, gentle and true
This is what a Saturday is supposed to do

[Chorus]
Sunny Saturday crew, Michelle on the court
Gentle little game, gentle little sport
Friends and a ball and a bright blue sky
Sunny Saturday crew, Michelle and I

[Verse 3]
Rotation in, rotation out
Nobody yelling, nobody shouts
Just soft little games and friendly little cheers
This is the best part of all the years

[Chorus]
Sunny Saturday crew, Michelle on the court
Gentle little game, gentle little sport
Friends and a ball and a bright blue sky
Sunny Saturday crew, Michelle and I

[Bridge]
Coffee after, lunch in the shade
Michelle's the reason these memories are made
Little bright ball, gentle little crew
Michelle on the court, Saturday is true

[Outro]
Sunny Saturday crew…
Michelle on the court…
Friends and a ball… forever in our heart…
